items.title: nbdkit: qcow2dec ZSTD heap over-read via incorrect input buffer size
items.summary: A flaw was found in nbdkit. The qcow2dec filter's zstd compressed cluster() function incorrectly sets the ZSTD input buffer size to the uncompressed cluster size instead of the compressed buffer size. A crafted QCOW2 image with ZSTD-compressed clusters can trigger a heap over-read, leading to a denial of service and potentially exposing heap memory.
